slides.title: US market entry in 2027: whether, and by which route

paragraphs.text: US market entry in 2027: whether, and by which route
Discussion document for the CEO and board, March 2027 board meeting
Onsoo Botanicals
CEO Park Ji-won and the board
Synthetic benchmark data; all figures from the briefing pack

slides.title: Executive summary

paragraphs.text: Executive summary
Enter the US in 2027 through Amazon, not national retail: only this route fits the board's limits, but it pays back by 2030 only if ad cost stays near the pilot's 28%
The US deserves Onsoo's one 2027 launch: K-beauty skincare grows fast, mostly on Amazon
–	K-beauty skincare grew 17% a year in 2021–25, against 5% for the market
–	Pilot units nearly doubled in five months, with repeat near the US benchmark
National retail fails the board's tests even on the planning team's own, optimistic inputs
–	Cumulative cash reaches −$20.8M by 2030; group margin falls to 4.5% in 2027
–	At today's awareness, newcomers sell 2.6 units per door a week, below the 4.0 cut-off
On planning inputs, Amazon-led entry alone passes every test, yet reaches two-thirds of the $40M ambition
–	Peak outflow is $1.9M against the $18M cap; group margin stays above 9%
–	Japan also passes but adds $7.0M of revenue in 2030, against $26.4M
Ad cost decides the payback: it holds only below an average ACoS of about 28.6%
–	At the 32% median for scaling brands, cash is still −$2.3M at end-2030; a 25% duty also breaks it
Launch with five gates, and add specialty retail only once awareness passes 20%, not 15%
–	If ad cost or repeat misses its end-2027 gate, hold US spend and bring the Japan scale-up forward

Each retail unit earns more than an Amazon unit, but the volume per door is too small
▪	A retail unit earns $7.55 against $4.73 for an Amazon unit at 25% ACoS, yet each door sells only 234 units a year
▪	Marketing and field costs are set per year, not per door, so a smaller launch keeps the same fixed cost
▪	The case rests on the 1.3 times Amazon halo, which a correlation of 0.71 across brands cannot prove (next pages)
▪	Even with that halo, the retail-led route ends 2030 at −$20.8M of cumulative cash
